notes: SharkOS 1.0.0 — the new Tesla-style look. Home: live map on the left, your Deep Sea Blue Shark 6 on the right (battery, range, now playing; tap the car for Controls). New bottom bar: volume, seat heat/cool and fan panels, linked temperatures with LO/HI (tap a temperature for Climate), Media/Maps/SharkEYE/Trips/Off-road/CarPlay/apps. Your Shark 6 spins at the top of Controls. Switch back any time in Settings → General → Home layout.
